observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== login page content ===" && curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:3000/login | grep -oiE "login|password|email|sign in|register" | sort -u | head
echo "=== compose ps ==="; docker compose ps --format 'table {{.Service}}\t{{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null
echo "=== restart counts ==="; for c in truspace-frontend truspace-backend ipfs0 cluster0 workspace-webui-1; do echo -n "$c: "; docker inspect -f '{{.RestartCount}} restarts, {{.State.Status}}' $c; done
echo "=== disk volumes ==="; du -sh volumes/* 2>/dev/null
